verdict.rationale: Teller documents a dedicated account balances API that returns "live, real-time account balances". Its site says these balances are intended for underwriting and for confirming sufficient funds before submitting an ACH debit, which matches the NSF/risk-check use case directly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time freshness, and documented detail on balance fields (available vs. ledger) and latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch a real-time balance for a connected account before initiating a payment — a documented balance endpoint intended for NSF and risk checks

citations.quote: The account balances API provides your application with live, real-time account balances.
Guaranteed live account balances. Used for underwriting or ensuring sufficient funds are available before submitting an ACH debit.
